root_cause: NOT a retrieval defect: the needle files are ABSENT from the index. The corpus walk indexed 3 datasets (json 2 records, opentelemetry-proto-docs 183, semantic-conventions-docs 2464 = 2,649 records from 329 walked files) while ALL 11 .proto files under opentelemetry/proto/ were silently UNASSIGNED — the terminal line says code_files=0 code_files_indexed=0, a wildcard ax_file=*trace.proto returns zero hits, and only 10 files were junk-marked. `.proto` is not in the tree-sitter code-extension registry, so the files fell out of the code family, and the dataset inference created only docs/json datasets — a file that lands in no dataset and no junk list is dropped with no record of the drop. Every top-5 hit is therefore a semantic-conventions .md file.
